name: Triparty Collateral Allegement Notification V 01
definition: Scope:|This message is sent by a triparty agent after the receipt of a collateral transaction or instruction from the collateral giver or taker to advise  that a counterparty has alleged an instruction or a transaction against the account owner's account at the TPA and that the TPA could not find the corresponding transaction or instruction of the account owner.|The allegement is used for initiation, modification and termination.||In this message, the Sender is the triparty agent and the Receiver is either the collateral taker or the collateral giver or their account servicer.||Usage:|An account servicer sends a SecuritiesSettlementTransactionAllegementNotification to an account owner to advise the account owner that a counterparty has alleged an instruction against the account owner's account at the account servicer and that the account servicer could not find the corresponding instruction of the account owner.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.

TransactionInstructionIdentification.name: Transaction Instruction Identification
TransactionInstructionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as know by the instructing party.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part preliminary advice is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part preliminary advice.

GeneralParameters.name: General Parameters
GeneralParameters.definition: Specifies the different parameters of the collateral instruction or transaction.

CollateralParties.name: Collateral Parties
CollateralParties.definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties. Party A and B will be the opposite  from that provided in the unmatched instruction.

DealTransactionDetails.name: Deal Transaction Details
DealTransactionDetails.definition: Specifies the information related to the deal.

DealTransactionDate.name: Deal Transaction Date
DealTransactionDate.definition: Identifies the dates related to the triparty collateral instruction or transactions.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
